_note: Job A batch 7. The last of the past-due queue, plus one amendment to moon-base-word after finding that Artemis II launched on 1 April 2026, three days from the date he gave, which the first pass missed.

evidence.summary: Amendment to the earlier entry. Artemis II, the first crewed flight to the Moon since 1972, launched on 1 April 2026, three days before the date he named. The NASA Moon Base announcement of three missions and a Phase One programme followed on 26 May 2026.
evidence.rationale: The first pass scored this against the May announcement and missed the closer event. Artemis II launched on 1 April, three days from the 4 April he gave, and it is the reason moon and space-race talk filled the news that month. The verdict does not change, and the reason is the launch date: Artemis II had a published NASA target window for early 2026 that had been publicly tracked for years, so the date was on a calendar rather than given. Both halves of the claim now have referents and both were foreseeable from public schedules.

evidence.summary: On 13-14 April 2024 Iran launched more than 300 drones and missiles at Israel, its first direct attack on Israeli territory, in response to the 1 April Israeli strike on the Iranian consulate in Damascus. Passover 2024 began on 22 April. Israel struck Iran in return on 19 April.
evidence.rationale: This is one of the better calls in the 2024 set. On 22 February he placed an acceleration at Passover around 21 April, and on 9 March said major events with Israel and a great escalation were attached to it. On 13 April Iran attacked Israel directly for the first time in the history of the two states, eight days from the date he gave and before the Damascus strike that triggered it had happened. Held at partial because escalation during an active regional war is a low bar and was being forecast widely in early 2024, and because the date is off by more than a week in a claim whose only specificity was the date.

evidence.summary: The Hur report of 8 February 2024 documented Biden's willful retention of classified material and significant memory limitations, and the White House counsel's office was shown to have asked for the language to be revised. Audio of the interview emerged later in 2024.
evidence.rationale: Significant revelations about Biden did surface in the first half of 2024, and he named the window and the person in December 2023. The base rate is the usual problem: an exposure claim about a sitting president in an election year is satisfied by any of the several investigations already running when he spoke. The distinctive imagery, a tape rewinding and the devil as the root, is scored under obama-era-exposure where the rewinding is given a destination.

evidence.summary: No disclosure linking the Biden circle back to Obama-era figures occurred in the first half of 2024. The thing described arrived thirteen months after the window closed, when DNI Gabbard declassified documents in July 2025 naming Obama, Clapper, Brennan, Rice, Kerry, Lynch and McCabe and sent a criminal referral to the Justice Department; contemporaneous fact-checking disputed her characterisation.
evidence.rationale: The window he gave was the beginning of 2024 and it closed empty. Something answering the description did happen later, and it is recorded here so that a reader can see both the miss and the near-miss, but a claim scored against a window it did not meet is a miss. Rolling it forward to July 2025 would be the hindsight the falsifier fields exist to stop.

evidence.summary: US real GDP grew 2.8 percent in 2024, unemployment stayed near historic lows, inflation fell toward target and the Federal Reserve began cutting rates in September. The soft-landing question was among the most discussed macroeconomic debates of 2024 in financial media through the spring.
evidence.rationale: Both halves are accurate: 2024 was presented as fine, and there was a televised soft-landing argument running through the spring. He said it on 14 December 2023, by which time the soft-landing debate had already been the dominant financial-media story for months and consensus forecasts had turned toward it. Describing the argument everyone was already having is not a forecast.

evidence.summary: About two million marriages take place in the United States each year. No listener outcome is recorded, and the claim is addressed to an unnamed audience.
evidence.rationale: The extractor's note is exact and was written before any outcome: some listeners will marry in 2026 and the rest are not counted. That is the whole structure. Recorded to close the row.

evidence.summary: The claim is a standing instruction to take 10,000 IU of vitamin D3 with K2 daily from October through the winter, flagged by him as what his family does rather than health advice. The NIH tolerable upper intake level for adults is 4,000 IU per day.
evidence.rationale: An instruction with no outcome attached, as the extractor recorded. Nothing here could have failed. The NIH upper limit is included in the summary because a reader checking this row deserves the number beside the dose, not because it bears on the verdict.

evidence.summary: No mechanism exists for observing whether listeners received a full year's provision in the first quarter of 2026. No aggregate income data show anything unusual in the quarter.
evidence.rationale: An instruction to believe for something, addressed to an unnamed audience, with the outcome private to each hearer. Restating it on 2 March with four weeks of the quarter left narrows the window but does not create an observer. Recorded to close the row.

evidence.summary: On 1 April 2026 Iranian drones hit fuel storage at Kuwait International Airport, three Iranian ballistic missiles were fired at Qatar with one striking a QatarEnergy-registered tanker, a man was killed by interception shrapnel in Fujairah, and a Houthi missile at Israel was intercepted. Artemis II launched the same day.
evidence.rationale: He said on 26 March that God would shake the nations on 1 April, and 1 April brought Iranian strikes on three Gulf states at once. That is a real hit on a named date. What holds it at partial is that the shaking was already underway: the Iran war had been running for a month when he spoke, with strikes on Gulf states and shipping occurring on most days, so a date picked anywhere in that fortnight would have produced something comparable. The three-year frame running to 2028 is not yet due and is not scored.

evidence.summary: Gun Violence Archive recorded 690 US mass shootings in 2021, 645 in 2022, 660 in 2023 and 502 in 2024, a decline of nearly 30 percent from the 2021 peak and the lowest since 2019, with the downward trend continuing since. No mass shooting or bombing occurred at a place of worship or celebration in the week following 26 March 2026.
evidence.rationale: The 2023 telling set the criterion as mass shootings at large gatherings increasing in the period following, and the published series went the other way by nearly a third. The 2026 telling named a one-week window over places of worship and celebration and nothing happened in it. Scored contradicted rather than expired because the measurable trend is not merely absent, it is a sustained decline over the whole period of the claim.

evidence.summary: On 15 July 2026 Japan's parliament passed legislation reclassifying digital assets from a payment regime to a financial-instruments regime, and South Korea's finance ministry unveiled a National Asset Basic Act folding crypto into the definition of state assets. Japan's FSA had already recognised qualifying foreign stablecoins as electronic payment instruments from 1 June 2026. Comparable US market-structure legislation had not passed.
evidence.rationale: Both named countries did legislate ahead of the United States, and the Sooners image, of those who took the land before the run was opened, fits what happened. The problem is priority again. Japan's reclassification bill and Korea's digital asset framework were both public legislative programmes with 2026 timetables well before the 16 June telling, and the 12 July telling is him reading a story dated 10 July. The corpus should be searched for the original Sooners word before this is credited further; on the record as extracted, the datable tellings all sit alongside or after the news.

evidence.summary: The World Cup final was played at MetLife Stadium on 19 July 2026 between Spain and Argentina under a SEAR 1 federal security designation with a match-day no-drone zone and the president in attendance. No incident occurred at any New York fixture. Security queues at the final exceeded two and a half hours in places.
evidence.rationale: He reads the published New York fixture list off the schedule and says so in the telling: he saw it on the schedule. There is no claim, only a list of dates to pray over, and the extractor treated it that way. Nothing happened at any of them. Recorded to close the row and as a marker of how much of the recent corpus is calendar reading.

evidence.summary: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center forecast Earth-directed coronal mass ejection arrivals from 29 July 2026 with geomagnetic storm watches for 29 to 31 July, and by 28 July said effects were easing. Within this corpus, uploads dated 16 to 18 July 2026 contain no reference to solar activity, flares or an earth-facing event; the 18 July material concerns earthquakes.
evidence.rationale: Two separate problems. The forecast he describes is a published NOAA product, so reporting it is not foresight. And the priority claim fails the archive: he says the Lord warned about it on the 17th, and the corpus has nothing solar in the 16 to 18 July uploads. This is the third claimed prior word in this database that the corpus does not contain, after the Yankees and drill baby drill.

evidence.summary: Iraqi oil production at the southern fields fell about 80 percent in March 2026, from roughly 4.3 million barrels a day before the war to 800,000, after the Strait of Hormuz closure and militia attacks on infrastructure. Iraq failed to pay July 2026 salaries to many public employees as oil revenue, about 90 percent of the federal budget, collapsed. Turkey exited the Iraq-Turkey Pipeline treaty in July 2026, and Kurdish exports to Ceyhan fell to 40,000-60,000 barrels a day from about 240,000.
evidence.rationale: The claim is Iraq rising out of the ashes with a great economic boom, oil wealth, Rolls-Royces and Saudi-scale infrastructure, given in April and repeated in July 2026. The Iraqi economy did the opposite in exactly that period: production down 80 percent, the state unable to pay wages, the export treaty with Turkey ended. He reads a pipeline story on 16 July as confirmation; the pipeline story of that month was Turkey's withdrawal. This is the clearest reversal in the recent material.

evidence.summary: No distinct wave of church scandal surfaced in July 2026 beyond the continuing cases scored under church-cleansing, and no set of plots was uncovered in the month that can be attributed to the prayers described.
evidence.rationale: Great darkness has no threshold and an exposing has no denominator, and the July telling adds a dark blanket of great distractions, which is satisfied by any news cycle. The 3 July telling makes the structure explicit: something about exposing darkness happened yesterday, unnamed, offered as encouragement that the prayers are working. Nothing here could have come out the other way.

evidence.summary: July 2026 brought repeated severe weather in the United States: tornadoes, damaging winds and flooding on 21 July across the Ohio valley, flash flooding around Chicago on 27 July, and an unprecedented heavy rain and flash flood event across eastern New York and western New England from 28 to 30 July. Tropical Storm Arthur had made landfall near Galveston in June with insured losses over one billion dollars.
evidence.rationale: There were major storms in July 2026 and he named the month in November 2025, eight months ahead. The base rate is close to total: July is the peak month for severe convective weather in the United States, which produces flooding and tornado outbreaks every year without exception, and a major storm in July is the safest weather claim available. He also arrives at July by moving forward from the 13 April date rather than receiving it, which the extractor recorded at the time.

evidence.summary: July 2026 brought the World Cup final on the 19th, Japanese and Korean crypto legislation on the 15th, Turkey's exit from the Iraq-Turkey pipeline treaty, and continued fallout from the Iran war. No development made a cleansing of the church visible from July.
evidence.rationale: The content is that July started the word, that the seventh month leads into the second half of the year, and that an acceleration follows for six months. Those are statements about the calendar. The one testable element, the church cleansing becoming visible from July, has no threshold and is already scored under church-cleansing. The August element and the six months following are not yet due.

evidence.summary: No identifiable division or turning point occurred in midsummer 2026 that matches the description. The cankerworm and devourer imagery comes from Joel 2:25.
evidence.rationale: A parting with no subject, no parties and no domain, offered alongside imagery about others being consumed while the listeners flourish. Any summer supplies a division somewhere and any audience supplies both outcomes. Recorded to close the row.

evidence.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky met senators at the Capitol on 28 July 2026 to press for additional US support, specifically antiballistic missiles. In early August he said the Ukrainian military faced a 27 billion dollar deficit and urged the EU to deliver a promised 90 billion euro loan; the EU released a further 6.1 billion euros in military aid before 24 August talks.
evidence.rationale: Said on 26 July, and two days later the Ukrainian president was on Capitol Hill asking for exactly that. The base rate removes almost all of it: Ukrainian requests for money and weapons have been a near-weekly feature of the news since February 2022, and the 28 July Senate meeting was on the published schedule. He also names nobody, so the claim is satisfied by any leader asking for aid in any given week.

evidence.summary: The holding that XRP is not in and of itself a security comes from Judge Analisa Torres in the Southern District of New York on 13 July 2023; institutional sales were held to be securities transactions. Ripple and the SEC withdrew their appeals in August 2025, closing the case. No separate federal ruling dated 18 August 2026 could be located, and the 18 August 2026 material is a Garlinghouse clip restating the existing holding alongside support for the Clarity Act.
evidence.rationale: The clip exists and Garlinghouse does say what he reports, so the narrow falsifier is met. The claim built on it is not: the ruling being quoted is three years old and predates the February 2026 vision by two and a half years, so a vision of him saying all we need is clarity is a vision of a line he has been repeating publicly since 2023. The three-banks-including-Chase detail has no referent. Scored partial for the clip and no higher, and the dating should be treated with care by anyone reading this thread.

evidence.summary: Reporting on 18 August 2026 stated that Starlink had partnerships with 48 airlines covering more than 7,000 aircraft equipped, in installation or under contract, up from two airline partners at the end of 2025 after 23 new deals in 2026.
evidence.rationale: The numbers are accurate and he is reading them off a news report published the same week. There is no claim of his attached, only the observation that Starlink is taking off. Recorded with the facts confirmed so the row closes, and noted as another calendar-and-clipping entry rather than a prediction.

evidence.summary: The claim is a declaration over listeners' marriages, children and households, with a five-month horizon to January 2027. No congregational or aggregate outcome is recorded or measurable.
evidence.rationale: The extractor marked the second telling not independently scoreable and the first is the same in substance with a horizon attached. A turnaround in wayward children across an unnamed audience is confirmed by one testimony and refuted by nothing. Recorded to close the row.

evidence.summary: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck off Flores, Indonesia on 15 August 2026 at 10 km depth on the Flores back-arc thrust, killing at least 111 people, injuring 1,678 and generating a tsunami of 1.61 m, followed by magnitude 5.9 and 5.6 aftershocks. USGS records 15 magnitude 7 or greater earthquakes globally in a typical year, all but a few on the Pacific ring of fire.
evidence.rationale: The events are real and correctly reported: a magnitude 7.7 and further large quakes on the ring of fire in the week to 20 August 2026. The telling is dated the 21st, after them, so this is description rather than prediction. And the reading placed on it, that this is an elevated rate amounting to shakings to awaken the world, does not survive the base rate: about 15 magnitude 7 events occur globally every year and roughly 90 percent of them are on the ring of fire, so a week containing one is ordinary. Scored partial for accurate reporting of real events, with the interpretation marked as unsupported.
